content:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER - P0: continuous-batch latency cliff (us-west-2) affecting /v1/generate streaming. Alert: 5xx spike and tail latency > 5s. Pager link: https://pager.company/incidents/CB-4410004321

alex: grabbing pager, oncall here. Observed many nodes with KV cache growth + eviction storms. Queue length for continuous-batch jumped. Starting triage.

sara: looking at logs now. tons of tiny microbatches + aggressive prefetch causing KV churn. evict rate metric: kvcache.evictions/sec spiked x12 since 4410004200.

jordan: graphs: https://grafana.company/d/cont-batch/usw2 - queue size and inflight microbatches correlate with CPU sys spikes. hypothesis: high concurrency -> many microbatches -> prefetch thrash -> hotspot evictions -> latency cliff.

alex: quick mitigation ideas: 1) disable prefetch for continuous-batch in us-west-2, 2) reduce max_microbatch_size and tighten max_batch_delay_ms to force bigger microbatches more predictably, 3) enable kv-eviction-throttle to reduce eviction storms. propose rolling config hotfix to controllers.

sara: agree. Also suggest revert of adaptive_prefetch_v2 rollout (went live ~4410002100). That feature seems to increase prefetch fanout under load.

ops-bot: starting canary config apply in us-west-2 (controllers: 6). change set id: cb-hotfix-4410004321. Will report back on apply status.

mike: preparing patch. config we plan to push: ```yaml
continuous_batch:
  max_microbatch_size: 8
  max_batch_delay_ms: 10
  prefetch:
    enabled: false
  kv_eviction_throttle_pct: 50
```

alex: executing hotpatch. command: ```kubectl apply -f /deploy/hotfixes/cb-hotfix-usw2.yaml --context=usw2-cluster``` then rolling restart controllers.

ops-bot: applied to 3/6 controllers - health checks passing. continuing.

ops-bot: applied to 6/6 controllers. rolling restarts completed.

sara: telemetry update: within 90s evictions/sec down ~80%, mem pressure falling. tail latency p95 -> 1.2s (from 6.1s). Good signal.

alex: customer impact: two heavy customers (acct-Delta, acct-Sparrow) reported errors and increased latency. CS notified via cs-team-bot.

cs-team-bot: Notified customer success for acct-Delta and acct-Sparrow, sent initial status message and ETA for mitigation ~15m.

jordan: note to follow up: need to revert or patch adaptive_prefetch_v2 logic - it over-prefetches under high concurrency and low seq-len workloads. Add regression test for concurrent-prefetch scenario.

alex: immediate next steps: monitor for 30m, run controlled kvcache stress test, open RCA ticket and assign to Sara + Jordan. Handing over to next oncall @mike at ts 4410004500. Include all logs and the applied patch id.

mike: ack, I will monitor for 30m and open PR to add throttling to adaptive_prefetch. Will also schedule controlled blast tests in staging.

alex: final notes:
- mitigation path: disable prefetch -> reduce microbatch frag -> throttle evictions.
- reason: multitenant fanout + microbatch jitter turned into a kvcache blowup.
- customer impact: transient 5xxs and slow streaming responses for some users; no data exposure.

sara: added short snippet to ops-runbook: commands to check kvcache metrics and force-change config: ```bash
# check kvcache evictions
curl -s http://metrics-svc.internal/metrics | rg kvcache.evictions
# apply hotfix
kubectl apply -f cb-hotfix-usw2.yaml --namespace=controller
```

mike: monitoring: p95 trending down, no new pager events in last 3m. leaving verbose logs on for 15m then will scale back.

alex: handing off. if anything flares, re-page. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident cb-4410004321 transitioned to "mitigated" at 4410004599.
